<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><title>Ally Quest — Welcome Street: Illustrated Adventure</title><style>
:root{font-family:ui-rounded,"Trebuchet MS","Arial Rounded MT Bold",system-ui,sans-serif;color:#16385d;--deep:#113d76;--ink:#1c3552;--purple:#66539f;--yellow:#ffc83a}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#66bceb}body{touch-action:manipulation}
.game{position:fixed;inset:0;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;background:linear-gradient(#7cbeef,#8cdab2)}
#home-art{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;user-select:none;overflow:hidden}
.action{cursor:pointer;outline:none}.action .button-inner{transition:filter .18s,transform .18s;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
.action:hover .button-inner,.action:focus-visible .button-inner{filter:brightness(1.055);transform:translateY(-3px)}.action:active .button-inner{transform:translateY(2px)}.action:focus-visible .button-inner{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px #ffb400)}
.wind-tree .canopy{transform-origin:10px 125px;animation:branchSway 6.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;transform-box:fill-box}
#tree-right .canopy{animation-delay:-2.4s;animation-duration:7.8s}
#tree-left .canopy{animation-duration:6.3s}
.wind-tree .tree-branches{transform-origin:0 270px;animation:trunkSway 8s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
#tree-right .tree-branches{animation-delay:-3s}
.drifting-leaf{animation:leafFloat var(--speed,10s) ease-in-out var(--delay,0s) infinite alternate}
.kid .kid-bob{animation:kidBreathe 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate;transform-origin:50% 98%;transform-box:fill-box}
#maya .kid-bob{animation-delay:-1.8s}#leo .kid-bob{animation-delay:-2.5s}#ari .kid-bob{animation-delay:-4s}
@keyframes branchSway{from{transform:rotate(-1.3deg) translateX(-3px)}to{transform:rotate(2deg) translateX(7px)}}
@keyframes trunkSway{from{transform:rotate(-.55deg)}to{transform:rotate(.8deg)}}
@keyframes leafFloat{from{translate:-7px 12px;rotate:-15deg}to{translate:18px -22px;rotate:35deg}}
@keyframes kidBreathe{from{transform:translateY(1px) rotate(-.25deg)}to{transform:translateY(-2px) rotate(.2deg)}}
.motion-off .wind-tree *, .motion-off .drifting-leaf,.motion-off .kid-bob{animation:none!important}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.wind-tree *, .drifting-leaf,.kid-bob{animation:none!important}}
#panel-backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(23,47,74,.34);backdrop-filter:blur(7px);padding:18px;z-index:10}#panel-backdrop.open{display:flex}
.panel{width:min(960px,100%);max-height:calc(100dvh - 36px);overflow:auto;border:5px solid #fff;border-radius:30px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#f9fffe,#eaf9f3 73%,#e0efe9);box-shadow:0 28px 65px #15386150,inset 0 3px 0 #fff;position:relative;padding:30px 34px 34px}
.panel h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,46px);line-height:1.05;margin:0 48px 9px 0;color:#1e416c;letter-spacing:-1.1px}.panel p{color:#53677b;font-size:16px;line-height:1.45}.panel-head{margin-bottom:22px}.close{position:absolute;top:23px;right:25px;border:2px solid #c5d6dd;background:white;color:#1e416c;font-size:27px;font-weight:900;line-height:1;border-radius:50%;width:45px;height:45px;cursor:pointer}.close:hover{background:#e5f4ff}
button{font-family:inherit}.primary{border:3px solid #fff;border-radius:17px;padding:13px 24px;font-size:19px;font-weight:900;color:#57301d;background:linear-gradient(#ffe078,#ffc02d);box-shadow:0 4px 0 #d9a144,0 8px 15px #204d5930;cursor:pointer}.primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.045);transform:translateY(-1px)}.primary:active{transform:translateY(2px)}.secondary{border:2px solid #d2e4e9;background:white;color:#29517a;border-radius:16px;padding:10px 18px;font-weight:900;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer}.secondary:hover{background:#f0f7fb}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}.tile{min-height:164px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;border:2px solid #d6e7e4;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#e8f7f4);padding:18px;text-align:left;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 5px 0 #bedcdb;cursor:pointer}.tile:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}.tile:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:#74bac6;background:#f8fff8}.tile .emoji{font-size:44px}.tile strong{font-size:19px;line-height:1.15}.tile span:last-child{font-size:13px;color:#567080}
.crew{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px}.crew .person{background:white;border:2px solid #d6e6df;border-radius:20px;padding:22px 12px;text-align:center}.crew .avatar{width:80px;height:80px;margin:auto auto 12px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:43px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#dbf5f7,#c5ebcc)}.crew strong{display:block;font-size:20px}.crew p{font-size:13px;margin-bottom:0}
.option-list{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.swatch{border:4px solid white;box-shadow:0 2px 8px #35546b55;border-radius:50%;width:62px;height:62px;cursor:pointer}.setting{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:18px;background:#fff;border:2px solid #d9eae6;border-radius:17px;padding:15px 18px;margin:11px 0;font-weight:800}.setting input{width:24px;height:24px;accent-color:#2a98af}
#toast{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:22px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#224e66f2;color:white;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 8px 20px #20455750;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s;z-index:14;text-align:center;white-space:normal;max-width:90vw}#toast.show{opacity:1}
@media (max-width:620px){.panel{padding:22px 17px;max-height:calc(100dvh - 22px);border-radius:24px}.panel h2{font-size:30px}.tiles{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.tile{min-height:135px;padding:13px}.crew{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.puzzle-buttons .primary{font-size:16px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.tree-top,#clouds,.flutter,.character .body-rise{animation:none!important}.action .button-inner{transition:none!important}}

/* Hand-illustrated all-code, animation and responsive refinements. */
html,body{overflow:hidden;background:#80cbf2}
#home-art{display:block;position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden}
.game{background:linear-gradient(#65b5f0,#c4eac0)}
.wind-tree .canopy{transform-origin:20px 210px;transform-box:fill-box;animation:windCanopy 6.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.wind-tree .tree-branches{transform-origin:17px 500px;transform-box:fill-box;animation:windTrunk 8s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
#tree-right .canopy{animation-duration:8.3s;animation-delay:-4.2s}
#tree-left .canopy{animation-duration:7.0s;animation-delay:-1.5s}
.drifting-leaf{animation:leafBreeze var(--speed,9s) ease-in-out var(--delay,0s) infinite alternate;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
.kid .kid-bob{animation:gentleBob 4.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 95%}
#maya .kid-bob{animation-delay:-1.9s}#leo .kid-bob{animation-delay:-2.4s}#ari .kid-bob{animation-delay:-.9s}
@keyframes windCanopy{0%{transform:rotate(-1.7deg) translateX(-6px)}100%{transform:rotate(2.4deg) translateX(8px)}}
@keyframes windTrunk{0%{transform:rotate(-.45deg)}100%{transform:rotate(.75deg)}}
@keyframes leafBreeze{0%{transform:translate(-9px,8px) rotate(-25deg)}100%{transform:translate(23px,-25px) rotate(28deg)}}
@keyframes gentleBob{0%{transform:translateY(2px)}100%{transform:translateY(-3px)}}
.action .button-inner{transform-origin:center;transform-box:fill-box;transition:filter .15s,transform .15s}
.action:hover .button-inner{filter:brightness(1.06);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.action:active .button-inner{transform:translateY(2px)}
.action:focus-visible{outline:5px solid #fff000;outline-offset:5px}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.wind-tree *, .drifting-leaf, .kid-bob{animation:none!important}}
.motion-off .wind-tree *, .motion-off .drifting-leaf,.motion-off .kid-bob{animation:none!important}
.portrait #ari-point-arm{display:none}

/* Detail pass: softer modeling and grounded character silhouettes. */
.kid{filter:drop-shadow(0 7px 12px rgba(16,61,56,.14))}
.kid .character-head{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.kid .kid-bob{animation:none!important}}

/* Faces: rounded eye proportions, controlled blinks and subtle reactions. */
.kid .eye-pair{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center center;animation:allyBlink 7.7s infinite}
#maya .eye-pair{animation-delay:-3.2s;animation-duration:9.2s}
#leo .eye-pair{animation-delay:-5.8s;animation-duration:8.1s}
#ari .expressive-smile{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;transition:transform .22s ease}
.kid:hover .expressive-smile{transform:scale(1.045)}
@keyframes allyBlink{0%,90%,92.1%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}91.05%{transform:scaleY(.1)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.kid .eye-pair{animation:none}}


/* Original vector characters are built from Bézier geometry, not image tracing. */
#home-art .kid{filter:none}
#home-art .kid-bob{animation:kidBreathe 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 94%}
#home-art .wind-tree .canopy{animation:branchSway 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center bottom}
#home-art #tree-right .canopy{animation-delay:-3.1s}
#home-art .drifting-leaf{animation:leafBreeze var(--speed,8s) ease-in-out var(--delay,0s) infinite alternate}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#home-art .kid-bob,#home-art .wind-tree .canopy,#home-art .drifting-leaf{animation:none!important}}


/* Individual artist-generated sprites replace ONLY the four legacy vector children.
   All tree shapes, animated canopies, sky, logos and buttons are the original editable code. */
.illustrated-kid { filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 5px rgba(16,55,51,.17)); transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin:center bottom; animation:allySpriteBreathe 5.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
#maya.illustrated-kid{animation-delay:-1.1s}#leo.illustrated-kid{animation-delay:-2.2s}#ari.illustrated-kid{animation-delay:-3.1s}
@keyframes allySpriteBreathe{from{transform:translateY(1px)}to{transform:translateY(-2px)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.illustrated-kid{animation:none!important}}
.crew .avatar{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid #e3edf2} .crew .avatar img{position:absolute;inset:0;display:block;width:100% !important;height:100% !important;max-height:none;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 20%}

/* Phase 0: modal usability only; does not alter approved home artwork. */
.panel .eyebrow {text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.13em;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;color:#367b83;margin:0 0 9px}
.panel .status-line {background:#edf7f7;border:1px solid #cde7e3;border-radius:13px;padding:12px 14px;font-weight:750;color:#31556f}
.panel .panel-actions {display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:19px}
.panel .coming-note {font-size:13px;color:#506a77}
.tile .preview-label {font-weight:800;font-size:12px;color:#3f6d82}
.panel .facts {display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:17px}
.panel .facts span {background:#fff;border:1px solid #d5e9e5;border-radius:99px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
#panel-backdrop.open .panel {animation:enterPanel .18s ease-out both}
@keyframes enterPanel {from{opacity:.6;transform:translateY(8px) scale(.99)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#panel-backdrop.open .panel{animation:none}}

/* Layout quality: prevent button text spilling outside compact portrait controls. */
.portrait #nav-map text,.portrait #nav-crew text,.portrait #nav-daily text{font-size:11px}
.portrait #nav-workshop text{font-size:10px}
#foreground-grounding{pointer-events:none}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.illustrated-kid,.wind-tree .canopy{animation:none!important}}

/* Ally Quest Movement Lab. Intentionally scoped: approved homepage pixels remain unchanged. */
.aq-play-root {position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;overflow:hidden;color:#183e5d;background:#8dcaea;font-family:ui-rounded,"Trebuchet MS",system-ui,sans-serif;isolation:isolate;touch-action:none}
.aq-play-root *, .aq-play-root *::before,.aq-play-root *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.aq-play-root canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;display:block;width:100%;height:100%;outline:none;touch-action:none}
.aq-hud{position:absolute;left:max(env(safe-area-inset-left),18px);right:max(env(safe-area-inset-right),18px);top:max(env(safe-area-inset-top),16px);display:flex;align-items:start;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;pointer-events:none}
.aq-level-label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:0;padding:11px 19px 12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.96);border-radius:21px;box-shadow:0 9px 24px rgba(29,79,107,.15)}
.aq-level-tag{letter-spacing:.13em;font-size:10px;color:#5d8792;font-weight:900}
.aq-level-label strong{font-size:clamp(15px,2vw,23px);font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.aq-level-label small{color:#557e83;font-weight:700;font-size:11px}
.aq-hud-right{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;pointer-events:auto}
.aq-pill,.aq-hud-button{color:#194d6a;background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);border:2px solid #fff;border-radius:100px;padding:10px 16px;box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(18,74,95,.14);font-weight:900;font-size:16px;white-space:nowrap}
.aq-hud-button{display:grid;place-items:center;width:49px;height:49px;padding:0;cursor:pointer;font-size:25px;line-height:1}
.aq-hud-button:hover,.aq-play-root button:hover{filter:brightness(1.05)}
.aq-hud-button:focus-visible,.aq-play-root button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #194974;outline-offset:3px}
.aq-hint{position:absolute;left:50%;top:max(110px,calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 99px));transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:17px;padding:10px 18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.91);font-size:14px;font-weight:850;color:#22536e;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(14,61,70,.1);max-width:min(600px,80vw);text-align:center;min-height:0;pointer-events:none}
.aq-hint:empty{display:none}
.aq-help{position:absolute;bottom:max(15px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));left:22px;display:flex;gap:17px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#184865;text-shadow:0 1px 1px #fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);border:2px solid #ffffff99;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:100px;pointer-events:none}
.aq-touch{display:none;pointer-events:auto;position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:max(env(safe-area-inset-bottom),14px);justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:12px}
.aq-dpad,.aq-actions{display:flex;align-items:end;gap:8px}
.aq-dpad button,.aq-actions button{width:66px;height:66px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8);border-radius:23px;background:rgba(246,250,250,.83);box-shadow:0 8px 20px #17406e27;font-size:22px;color:#214c6b;font-weight:1000;touch-action:none;user-select:none;cursor:pointer}
.aq-actions button.aq-jump{background:#ffd25c;color:#74400d;min-width:89px;font-size:17px;border-color:#fff5d7}
.aq-actions button.aq-dash{background:#a7e4ea}
.aq-dpad button.down,.aq-actions button.down{transform:translateY(2px) scale(.96);background:#bae5a9}
.aq-tb-middle{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
.aq-tb-middle button{width:50px;height:37px;border-radius:12px;font-size:17px}
.aq-screen-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:22px;background:rgba(22,53,75,.42);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);pointer-events:auto}
.aq-screen-overlay[hidden]{display:none}
.aq-screen-card{max-width:min(550px,94vw);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;border:4px solid #fff;border-radius:32px;background:linear-gradient(175deg,#fefcf2,#e9f7e7);padding:clamp(24px,4vw,38px);box-shadow:0 26px 70px #17415d5c;text-align:center}
.aq-screen-card h2{color:#183e5d;margin:0 0 10px;font-size:clamp(25px,4vw,37px);line-height:1.06;font-weight:1000}
.aq-screen-card p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;margin:8px 0 24px;color:#557579}
.aq-card-actions{display:flex;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.aq-card-actions button{border:3px solid white;border-radius:20px;padding:12px 19px;font-weight:900;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;color:#1f546f;background:#e5f4ef;box-shadow:0 5px 11px #23607126}
.aq-card-actions .aq-primary{background:#ffd253;color:#73430d}
@media (pointer:coarse), (max-width:780px){.aq-touch{display:flex}.aq-help{display:none}.aq-hint{top:max(105px,calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 87px));font-size:12px}.aq-level-label{padding:8px 12px;border-radius:13px}.aq-level-label strong{font-size:15px}.aq-level-label small{display:none}.aq-level-tag{font-size:9px}.aq-hud{left:10px;right:10px;top:max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-top))}.aq-hud-right{gap:5px}.aq-pill{font-size:12px;padding:9px 8px}.aq-hud-button{width:39px;height:39px;font-size:22px}.aq-dpad button,.aq-actions button{width:61px;height:61px}.aq-actions button.aq-jump{min-width:76px}}
@media (max-width:440px){.aq-time{display:none}.aq-dpad{gap:4px}.aq-actions{gap:5px}.aq-dpad button,.aq-actions button{width:56px;height:59px;border-radius:18px}.aq-actions button.aq-jump{min-width:73px}.aq-tb-middle button{width:43px;height:30px}.aq-level-label{max-width:145px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.aq-play-root button{transition:none}}

</style></head><body><div id="app"></div><script>/* module: game/physics/types */
const EMPTY_INPUT = { x: 0, y: 0, jump: false, jumpHeld: false, interact: false, dash: false };
const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v));
const approach = (v, t, d) => v < t ? Math.min(t, v + d) : Math.max(t, v - d);
const intersect = (a, b) => a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
const distance = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);

/* module: game/physics/SideWorld */
/** Deterministic platformer with continuous movement, colliders and physical props. */
class SideWorld {
    mode = 'side';
    width = 3250;
    height = 760;
    player = { x: 82, y: 565, vx: 0, vy: 0 };
    ball = { x: 2125, y: 540, vx: 0, vy: 0 };
    ribbons = [{ x: 298, y: 429, got: false, id: 1 }, { x: 612, y: 388, got: false, id: 2 }, { x: 1120, y: 430, got: false, id: 3 }, { x: 1790, y: 365, got: false, id: 4 }, { x: 2800, y: 450, got: false, id: 5 }];
    platforms = [

/** Frame-rate-independent physics tick with bounded catch-up on tab switching. */
class FixedClock {

            update(this.dt);
            this.accumulator -= this.dt;
            n++;

            this.accumulator = Math.min(this.accumulator, this.dt);

    const serial = Math.floor(Date.UTC(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate()) / 86400000);
    const kind = ['stars', 'secrets', 'smooth'][((serial % 3) + 3) % 3];
    const label = { stars: ['Star Safari', 'Find all five stars in one run.'], secrets: ['Secret Explorer', 'Discover both hidden surprises in one run.'], smooth: ['Smooth Runner', 'Deliver the banner without a respawn, outside practice mode.'] }[kind];
    return { date: dateKey, kind, title: label[0], description: label[1] };
}
function completedDaily(run, goal) {
    return goal.kind === 'stars' ? run.stars === 5 : goal.kind === 'secrets' ? run.secrets === 2 : !run.practiceMode && run.attempts === 0;
}

/* module: game/replay/ReplayChallenge */
/** Non-identifying on-device best records; resettable by clearing browser storage. */
const REPLAY_KEY = 'allyquest.welcome.replay.v1';
const allMedals = ['first-finish', 'star-collector', 'secret-scout', 'smooth-landing', 'quick-quest', 'friend-of-maya'];

}

    'first-finish': 'Banner Hero', 'star-collector': 'Star Collector', 'secret-scout': 'Secret Scout',

        const medals = ['first-finish'];
        if (run.stars === 5)
            medals.push('star-collector');
        if (run.secrets === 2)
            medals.push('secret-scout');
        if (!run.practiceMode && run.attempts === 0)
            medals.push('smooth-landing');
        if (!run.practiceMode && run.seconds <= 180)
            medals.push('quick-quest');
        if (run.metMaya)
            medals.push('friend-of-maya');
        const unlocked = medals.filter(m => !this.state.medals.includes(m));
        const today = dailyFor(), dailySuccess = completedDaily(run, today);
        const days = dailySuccess && !this.state.dailyCleared.includes(today.date) ? [...this.state.dailyCleared, today.date].slice(-31) : this.state.dailyCleared;
        const isBest = !run.practiceMode && (this.state.bestTime === null || run.seconds < this.state.bestTime);

            bestTime: isBest ? run.seconds : this.state.bestTime,
            fewestAttempts: !run.practiceMode && (this.state.fewestAttempts === null || run.attempts < this.state.fewestAttempts) ? run.attempts : this.state.fewestAttempts,
            maxStars: Math.max(this.state.maxStars, run.stars), maxSecrets: Math.max(this.state.maxSecrets, run.secrets),

    land: { freq: 145, end: .085, shape: 'triangle', gain: .018, slide: .70 },
    bounce: { freq: 360, end: .28, shape: 'triangle', gain: .060, slide: 2.3 },
    step: { freq: 120, end: .046, shape: 'triangle', gain: .008, slide: .75 },
    ribbon: { freq: 760, end: .23, shape: 'sine', gain: .05, slide: 1.38 },
    secret: { freq: 500, end: .29, shape: 'sine', gain: .042, slide: 2.0 },
    checkpoint: { freq: 520, end: .19, shape: 'sine', gain: .039, slide: 1.38 },
    gate: { freq: 240, end: .22, shape: 'triangle', gain: .033, slide: 1.8 },
    respawn: { freq: 290, end: .15, shape: 'sine', gain: .022, slide: .70 },
    finish: { freq: 620, end: .36, shape: 'sine', gain: .061, slide: 1.62 },

/* module: game/audio/AmbientScore */
/** Tiny original four-bar Ally Quest motif, synthesized locally; no network/audio files. */
class AmbientScore {
    next = 0;
    index = 0;
    tones = [392, 440, 523.25, 587.33, 523.25, 440, 392, 329.63, 349.23, 392, 466.16, 523.25, 440, 392, 349.23, 329.63];
    reset() { this.next = 0; this.index = 0; }
    step(ctx, muted, paused) {
        if (!ctx || muted || paused || ctx.state !== 'running') {
            this.next = 0;
            return;
        }
        const now = ctx.currentTime;
        if (this.next === 0 || now > this.next + 2)
            this.next = now + .07;
        if (now + 0.04 < this.next)
            return;
        const frequency = this.tones[this.index % this.tones.length];
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator(), gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.type = 'sine';
        osc.frequency.value = frequency;
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.00001, this.next);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.009, this.next + .055);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.00001, this.next + .49);
        osc.connect(gain).connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.start(this.next);
        osc.stop(this.next + .5);
        this.next += .66;
        this.index++;
    }
}

        this.poly([[x - 19, y + 2], [x + w / 2, y - 43], [x + w / 2, y - 34], [x - 13, y + 11]], '#718faa');
        this.poly([[x + w / 2, y - 43], [x + w + 20, y + 2], [x + w + 11, y + 11], [x + w / 2, y - 34]], '#3d587a');
        for (let row = 0; row < 3; row++) {
            const yy = y - 31 + row * 9;
            this.line(x + w / 2 - (35 - row * 13), yy, x + w / 2 + (35 - row * 13), yy, 'rgba(220,236,245,.18)', 1.1);
        }
        this.line(x - 16, y + 1, x + w + 16, y + 1, '#f8efdc', 5);
        this.poly([[x + w + 15, y], [x + w + 28, y - 7], [x + w + 25, y + 1], [x + w + 15, y + 8]], '#38516d');
        this.box(x + 7, y + 5, w - 14, 8, 'rgba(255,250,223,.22)', 4);
        for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
            const winx = x + 20 + k * (w - 40) / 3, wy = y + 42;
            this.box(winx, wy, 28, 45, '#fff7dd', 3);
            this.box(winx + 4, wy + 4, 20, 35, '#68b3c9', 2);
            this.line(winx + 14, wy + 3, winx + 14, wy + 40, '#fff8dd', 2);
            this.line(winx + 3, wy + 21, winx + 26, wy + 21, '#fff9e4', 2);
            this.poly([[winx + 4, wy + 5], [winx + 10, wy + 5], [winx + 4, wy + 18]], 'rgba(255,255,255,.5)');
        }
        const doorX = x + w * .59, doorY = y + h - 69;
        this.box(doorX, doorY, 38, 58, '#fff5df', 5);
        this.box(doorX + 4, doorY + 5, 30, 50, '#527f91', 3);
        this.oval(doorX + 26, doorY + 34, 2.5, 2.5, '#f8c959');
        this.line(x - 14, y + 22, x + w + 18, y + 22, '#fff3dc', 6);
        if (type % 2) {
            this.box(x + 26, y + 101, w * .55, 12, '#fff4e6', 2);
            for (let k = 0; k < 7; k++)
                this.poly([[x + 27 + k * (w * .55 / 7), y + 101], [x + 27 + (k + .5) * (w * .55 / 7), y + 113], [x + 27 + (k + 1) * (w * .55 / 7), y + 101]], k % 2 ? '#f9efe3' : '#df8268');
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < Math.floor(w / 17); i++) {
            const xx = x + 7 + i * 17;
            this.oval(xx, y + h - 4, 14, 12, i % 2 ? '#4b976a' : '#6bb171');
        }
    }
    worldBehind(t, quiet, minX = -9999, maxX = 9999) {
        const c = this.c;
        // Architecture is scenic only and sits behind the actual gameplay colliders.
        if (-155 + 260 > minX && -155 < maxX)
            this.building(-155, 343, 260, 195, 0, t);
        if (290 + 245 > minX && 290 < maxX)
            this.building(290, 325, 245, 215, 1, t);
        if (740 + 224 > minX && 740 < maxX)
            this.building(740, 352, 224, 177, 2, t);
        if (1155 + 390 > minX && 1155 < maxX)
            this.school(1155, 256, 390, 283, t);
        if (1680 + 255 > minX && 1680 < maxX)
            this.building(1680, 341, 255, 204, 0, t);
        if (2210 + 285 > minX && 2210 < maxX)
            this.building(2210, 330, 285, 212, 4, t);
        if (2710 + 286 > minX && 2710 < maxX)
            this.building(2710, 346, 286, 195, 2, t);
        // Two-tier fence spans the empty spaces and grounds the structures.
        for (let i = Math.max(0, Math.floor((minX + 50) / 19)); i < Math.min(190, Math.ceil((maxX + 50) / 19)); i++) {
            const x = i * 19 - 50;
            this.line(x, 538, x, 503, '#f1e2c9', 6);
            this.poly([[x - 4, 504], [x, 494], [x + 4, 504]], '#fbefdb');
        }
        this.box(-50, 519, 3400, 7, '#ebdeca', 2);
        this.box(-50, 535, 3400, 7, '#ebdeca', 2);
        // Trees pivot at the roots, with separated canopies and subtle wind rotation.
        for (let i = 0; i < 29; i++) {
            const x = 100 + i * 117 + noise(i * 13) * 39;
            if (x < minX - 60 || x > maxX + 60)
                continue;
            const y = 543;
            const height = 125 + noise(i * 3) * 40;
            const size = 25 + noise(i + 7) * 12;
            this.tree(x, y, height, size, t + i * .43, quiet, i % 4 === 0);
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < 65; i++) {
            const x = 42 + i * 51, y = 551 + noise(i * 31) * 8;
            if (x < minX - 20 || x > maxX + 20)
                continue;
            this.oval(x, y, 10 + noise(i + 4) * 10, 7, i % 3 ? '#69b97a' : '#4d9f70');
        }
    }
    school(x, y, w, h, t) {
        const c = this.c;
        this.box(x - 35, y + h, w + 75, 10, 'rgba(44,74,72,.18)', 7);
        this.poly([[x + w, y], [x + w + 30, y - 23], [x + w + 30, y + h], [x + w, y + h]], '#a35547');
        this.box(x, y, w, h, '#bb6e56', 3);
        for (let yy = y + 19; yy < y + h; yy += 16) {
            this.line(x, yy, x + w, yy, '#cf876b', 1);
            for (let xx = x + ((yy - y) % 32 ? 11 : 0); xx < x + w; xx += 38)
                this.line(xx, yy, xx, yy + 13, '#a95e50', 1);
        }
        this.box(x + 14, y + 13, w - 28, 26, '#e4c4a2', 1);
        this.box(x - 8, y + 40, w + 16, 8, '#f6dfc0', 3);
        this.poly([[x - 26, y + 12], [x + w * .5, y - 64], [x + w + 24, y + 12]], '#536b86');
        this.poly([[x - 10, y + 5], [x + w * .5, y - 43], [x + w + 12, y + 5]], '#687d96');
        this.line(x - 23, y + 11, x + w + 23, y + 11, '#f8e2bf', 7);
        this.oval(x + w * .5, y + 20, 24, 24, '#fff8e5');
        this.oval(x + w * .5, y + 20, 19, 19, '#3b7097');
        this.oval(x + w * .5, y + 20, 15, 15, '#fbefd8');
        this.line(x + w * .5, y + 20, x + w * .5, y + 10, '#384e6c', 2);
        this.line(x + w * .5, y + 20, x + w * .5 + 8, y + 24, '#384e6c', 2);
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            const wx = x + 31 + i * 66;
            this.box(wx, y + 80, 36, 68, '#fff3d8', 3);
            this.box(wx + 5, y + 5 + 80, 26, 58, '#70b4c5', 2);
            this.line(wx + 18, y + 84, wx + 18, y + 146, '#f8f1d9', 3);
            this.line(wx + 5, y + 118, wx + 31, y + 118, '#f8f1d9', 3);
        }
        this.box(x + w * .41, y + h - 120, w * .2, 120, '#f4dbc0', 4);
        this.box(x + w * .43, y + h - 112, w * .16, 112, '#426d89', 3);
        this.box(x + w * .38, y + h - 15, w * .26, 15, '#ead2b4');
        for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            this.box(x + w * .33 - j * 7, y + h - 1 + j * 7, w * .36 + j * 14, 7, '#d3c3a9', 2);
        }
        this.box(x + w * .30, y + 147, w * .4, 34, '#f5e4c7', 6);
        c.font = '900 20px ui-rounded, system-ui';
        c.fillStyle = '#29476b';
        c.textAlign = 'center';
        c.fillText('WELCOME STREET', x + w / 2, y + 171);
        c.textAlign = 'start';
        const sway = Math.sin(t * 2) * 3;
        this.line(x + w * .5, y - 63, x + w * .5, y - 98, '#886748', 3);
        this.poly([[x + w * .5, y - 97], [x + w * .5 + 48, y - 97 + sway], [x + w * .5 + 44, y - 85 + sway], [x + w * .5, y - 85]], '#ffbb56');
    }
    tree(x, y, h, r, t, quiet, pine) {
        const c = this.c;
        const sway = quiet ? 0 : Math.sin(t * .8) * 2.6;
        this.oval(x + 6, y + 2, r * .9, 5, 'rgba(49,79,48,.16)');
        this.poly([[x - 7, y], [x - 5, y - h * .8], [x + 3 + sway, y - h * .94], [x + 10, y], [x + 4, y + 3]], '#92653e');
        this.line(x, y - h * .65, x - r * .8 + sway, y - h * .80, '#86613c', 5);
        this.line(x, y - h * .6, x + r * .7 + sway, y - h * .79, '#86613c', 4);
        c.save();
        c.translate(sway, 0);
        if (pine) {
            for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                const yy = y - h * .95 + k * 21;
                this.poly([[x, yy - 37], [x - r * (1 + k * .22), yy + 18], [x + r * (1 + k * .22), yy + 18]], k % 2 ? '#318d66' : '#4caa78');
            }
        }
        else {
            const leaves = ['#3b9862', '#51a96e', '#65b975', '#78c57b', '#8ccc7b', '#a4d987'];
            const clusters = [[-.58, -.86, .73], [-.08, -1.10, .8], [.57, -.94, .8], [.9, -.75, .65], [-.9, -.69, .55], [.02, -.77, .92], [.3, -1.25, .6], [-.4, -1.2, .55], [.1, -.55, .54]];
            for (let k = 0; k < clusters.length; k++) {
                const [px, py, scale] = clusters[k];
                const xx = x + px * r, yy = y + py * h;
                const gr = c.createRadialGradient(xx - r * .25, yy - r * .28, 2, xx, yy, r * scale);
                gr.addColorStop(0, leaves[Math.min(5, k % 6 + 1)]);
                gr.addColorStop(.65, leaves[k % 5]);
                gr.addColorStop(1, leaves[Math.max(0, k % 4)]);
                this.oval(xx, yy, r * scale, r * scale * .76, gr);
            }
            for (let k = 0; k < 22; k++) {
                const xx = x + (noise(k * 7 + x) - .5) * r * 2.3, yy = y - h * (.60 + .63 * noise(k * 11 + x));
                this.oval(xx, yy, 2 + noise(k + 9) * 2.7, 1.1 + noise(k + 13) * 1.2, k % 4 ? '#b3db7b' : '#e2eaa3');
            }
        }
        c.restore();
    }
    platform(p) {
        const moving = Boolean(p.moving), ground = p.id.startsWith('ground');
        const c = this.c;
        if (ground) {
            this.box(p.x, p.y, p.w, Math.max(p.h, 900), '#916c54', 1);
            this.box(p.x, p.y, p.w, 8, '#8ccc4b', 2);
            const g = c.createLinearGradient(0, p.y, 0, p.y + 70);
            g.addColorStop(0, '#bca07c');
            g.addColorStop(1, '#936e55');
            this.box(p.x, p.y + 8, p.w, 90, '#ad8564');
            for (let yy = p.y + 17; yy < p.y + Math.max(p.h, 650); yy += 28) {
                this.line(p.x + 3, yy, p.x + p.w - 3, yy, 'rgba(75,55,47,.27)', 2);
                for (let xx = p.x + (yy % 56 ? 10 : 24); xx < p.x + p.w; xx += 68)
                    this.line(xx, yy, xx + 10, yy + 27, 'rgba(68,55,47,.23)', 2);
            }
            this.box(p.x, p.y + 3, p.w, 10, '#599e52', 2);
            for (let i = Math.ceil(p.x / 29) * 29; i < p.x + p.w; i += 29) {
                this.oval(i, p.y + 3, 17, 6, i % 3 === 0 ? '#8bcd55' : '#6bb34f');
            }
            for (let i = Math.ceil(p.x / 62) * 62; i < p.x + p.w; i += 62) {
                this.oval(i, p.y + 40, 6, 3, 'rgba(255,237,197,.2)');
                this.oval(i + 18, p.y + 84, 4, 2, 'rgba(74,55,50,.16)');
            }
        }
        else {
            this.box(p.x + 8, p.y + 11, p.w - 11, 14, 'rgba(38,67,55,.24)', 4);
            this.poly([[p.x, p.y + 9], [p.x + 9, p.y + 16], [p.x + p.w + 8, p.y + 16], [p.x + p.w, p.y + 9]], moving ? '#347da4' : '#795a49');
            this.box(p.x, p.y + 5, p.w, 15, moving ? '#4189a6' : '#936c53', 5);
            this.box(p.x, p.y, p.w, 11, moving ? '#60c5d7' : '#83bf51', 6);
            for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                this.oval(p.x + 15 + i * (p.w - 30) / 2, p.y + 16, 2.3, 2.3, '#e8f5d3');
            }
            if (!moving) {
                for (let i = 1; i < 6; i++)
                    this.line(p.x + i * p.w / 6, p.y + 8, p.x + i * p.w / 6 - 3, p.y + 18, 'rgba(77,58,47,.3)', 1);
            }
        }
    }
    spring(x, y, w, t) {
        this.box(x - 3, y + 10, w + 6, 8, '#415b72', 3);
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            this.line(x + 5 + i * 13, y + 10, x + 11 + i * 13, y - 2, '#d99a3c', 3);
        this.box(x, y - 6, w, 12, '#4189c6', 7);
        this.box(x + 4, y - 9, w - 8, 7, '#ffd569', 4);
        this.line(x + 10, y - 6, x + w - 12, y - 6, '#fffbd0', 2);
    }
    hero(p, grounded, t) {
        const c = this.c;
        const running = Math.abs(p.vx) > 50;
        const air = !grounded;
        const cycle = t * (running ? 16 : 3);
        const step = running ? Math.sin(cycle) : 0;
        const bob = running ? Math.abs(step) * 1.7 : Math.sin(t * 2) * .7;
        c.save();
        c.translate(p.x, p.y - bob);
        c.scale(p.vx < -10 ? -1 : 1, 1);
        this.oval(0, 3, 23, 6, 'rgba(35,67,60,.24)');
        c.save();
        c.translate(0, -22);
        if (air) {
            this.line(-7, 9, -21, 21, '#f3b78d', 7);
            this.line(6, 9, 23, 17, '#f3b78d', 7);
        }
        else {
            this.line(-7, 10, -9 - step * 10, 25 - Math.max(0, step) * 8, '#ad7048', 8);
            this.line(7, 10, 9 + step * 10, 25 - Math.max(0, -step) * 8, '#ad7048', 8);
        }
        const feet = air ? [[-22, 22], [21, 17]] : [[-9 - step * 10, 25 - Math.max(0, step) * 8], [9 + step * 10, 25 - Math.max(0, -step) * 8]];
        for (const [x, y] of feet) {
            this.box(x - 8, y - 6, 19, 10, '#eaf6fc', 5);
            this.box(x - 8, y, 19, 5, '#285b92', 4);
        }
        c.restore();
        // backpack with highlights and layered clothing
        this.box(-24, -50, 22, 36, '#245c90', 9);
        this.box(-26, -41, 9, 22, '#1c416c', 4);
        this.box(-23, -48, 8, 9, '#ecb254', 3);
        const cloth = c.createLinearGradient(-12, -49, 22, -8);
        cloth.addColorStop(0, '#50b2c8');
        cloth.addColorStop(.62, '#2796b3');
        cloth.addColorStop(1, '#186d9c');
        this.box(-15, -48, 35, 38, cloth, 13); // overwritten below by gradient fill through c
        c.fillStyle = cloth;
        c.beginPath();
        c.roundRect(-15, -48, 35, 38, 13);
        c.fill();
        this.line(-7, -44, 2, -32, '#8cdae1', 2);
        this.line(8, -44, 12, -34, '#8cdae1', 2);
        this.line(-10, -37, -20 + (running ? step * 9 : 0), -22 + (air ? -9 : 0), '#f0b58e', 7);
        this.line(14, -37, 22 - (running ? step * 9 : 0), -22 + (air ? -13 : 0), '#f1b991', 7);
        this.oval(-20 + (running ? step * 9 : 0), -22 + (air ? -9 : 0), 4.4, 4.5, '#f5c39b');
        this.oval(22 - (running ? step * 9 : 0), -22 + (air ? -13 : 0), 4.2, 4.4, '#f5c39b');
        // fully rounded child-like head
        const face = c.createRadialGradient(-5, -71, 3, 4, -68, 28);
        face.addColorStop(0, '#ffe4bf');
        face.addColorStop(.67, '#f9c79b');
        face.addColorStop(1, '#e8a77c');
        this.oval(0, -66, 24, 25, face);
        c.fillStyle = face;
        c.beginPath();
        c.ellipse(0, -66, 24, 25, 0, 0, PI2);
        c.fill();
        this.oval(-22, -62, 5.7, 7, '#f5bd8e');
        this.oval(20, -64, 4.5, 6, '#edb18a');
        this.oval(-12, -58, 5, 3, 'rgba(235,116,95,.22)');
        this.oval(13, -56, 5, 3, 'rgba(229,103,92,.20)');
        // messy hair has nested volume, no oval skin above it.
        this.oval(-7, -86, 22, 12, '#653923');
        this.oval(7, -87, 19, 11, '#6e3c25');
        this.oval(-18, -80, 10, 10, '#78432b');
        this.oval(18, -80, 9, 9, '#6e3e2b');
        for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
            const xx = -17 + k * 9;
            this.oval(xx, -90 + noise(k + 2) * 5, 7 + noise(k) * 4, 7, '#844c2e');
            this.line(xx - 3, -92, xx + 1, -95, '#b97943', 1.7);
        }
        for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
            const x = -7 + k * 13;
            this.oval(x, -66, 5, 7, '#fffdf6');
            this.oval(x + 1, -66, 2.4, 3.8, '#54332c');
            this.oval(x + 1.5, -68, 1.1, 1.4, 'white');
        }
        this.line(-11, -77, -5, -78, '#744532', 2);
        this.line(5, -77, 12, -75, '#744532', 2);
        this.oval(3, -59, 2.2, 1.5, '#e3a07b');
        c.fillStyle = '#843f3c';
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(-5, -53);
        c.quadraticCurveTo(2, -46, 12, -54);
        c.quadraticCurveTo(8, -43, 2, -43);
        c.quadraticCurveTo(-5, -44, -5, -53);
        c.fill();
        this.line(-4, -53, 11, -53, '#fff6e8', 2.4);
        c.restore();
    }
    npc(x, y, t, id = 'maya') {
        const c = this.c;
        c.save();
        c.translate(x, y + Math.sin(t * 2 + id.length) * 1.5);
        this.oval(0, 1, 23, 5, 'rgba(21,72,54,.2)');
        this.line(-8, -18, -8, 0, '#424c70', 7);
        this.line(9, -18, 9, 0, '#424c70', 7);
        this.box(-18, -50, 35, 34, id === 'maya' ? '#ab77cc' : id === 'leo' ? '#61b2b6' : '#b1a5e6', 11);
        this.line(-16, -37, -26, -24, '#b37c5c', 8);
        this.line(17, -37, 24, -27, '#bb8967', 8);
        this.oval(0, -67, 23, 24, id === 'maya' ? '#dca77c' : '#f7c79d');
        const hair = id === 'maya' ? '#493026' : id === 'leo' ? '#ad6131' : '#29232d';
        if (id === 'maya') {
            for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++)
                this.oval(-23 + i * 6, -83 + Math.sin(i * 2) * 3, 10, 9, hair);
            this.line(-20, -88, 18, -88, '#a577d1', 4);
        }
        else if (id === 'leo') {
            this.oval(0, -87, 26, 9, '#2469b1');
            this.box(-24, -87, 42, 8, '#237cc1', 5);
        }
        else {
            this.oval(0, -84, 24, 12, hair);
            this.oval(-17, -66, 7, 25, hair);
        }
        for (const xx of [-8, 8]) {
            this.oval(xx, -66, 5, 6, 'white');
            this.oval(xx + 1, -65, 2.5, 3.6, '#50352c');
        }
        if (id === 'maya') {
            for (const xx of [-8, 8]) {
                c.strokeStyle = '#9366ca';
                c.lineWidth = 3;
                c.beginPath();
                c.arc(xx, -66, 8, 0, PI2);
                c.stroke();
            }
            this.line(-1, -66, 1, -66, '#9e78d7', 3);
        }
        this.line(-7, -53, 6, -52, '#85463d', 2);
        c.restore();
    }
    foreground(w, h, t, quiet) {
        const c = this.c;
        // Restricted to thin bottom corners so interactive objects remain unobstructed.
        for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
            const x = (i < 12 ? i * 28 : w - (i - 11) * 25), y = h + 5;
            c.save();
            c.translate(x, y);
            c.rotate((i % 2 ? 1 : -1) * .2 + (quiet ? 0 : Math.sin(t * .75 + i) * .03));
            this.poly([[0, 0], [-7, -14], [-4, -31], [5, -17], [11, -28], [10, 0]], i % 3 ? 'rgba(37,117,73,.58)' : 'rgba(82,155,74,.55)');
            c.restore();
        }
    }
}

/* module: game/render/ArtAssets */
const GAME_ART = {
    panorama: 'data:image/webp;base64,
